data.value: • Memory Storage:Named RAM locations holding data temporarily during execution. • Dynamic Values:Data changes during runtime; referenced via unique programmer-defined names. • Syntax:Declared using Dim and explicit types: Dim studentName As String = "Bernard" • Scope:Governs accessibility (Local procedure vs. Global module level).

data.name: RichTextBox2.Text
data.value: • Text Storage: String: Stores sequences of text, words, and non-calculated characters. Char: Stores a single Unicode character. • Precision Decimals: Decimal: High-precision storage for financial calculations and currency. Double / Single: Floating-point numbers for scientific and mathematical values. • Logic & Date:Boolean: Holds binary state values (True or False). Date: Stores calendar dates and system time formats.
